title: CSCI 399 — CS Undergraduate Part-time Co-op
subject: Computing Practice and Research
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define cooperative education as a part-time work experience that supplements the academic curriculum.
Identify the prerequisite course requirement and typical term offerings for CSCI-399.
Apply ACM ethical principles and responsible technical communication standards to co-op project planning and evaluation.
